tools.name: analyze_slx
tools.title: Analyze Simulink SLX Model
tools.description: Parses a Simulink .slx model file and extracts a structured ModelFactBundle containing interfaces (Inport/Outport), subsystems, Stateflow states, tunable parameters, logic rules (Switch/If/RelationalOperator), timing information, diagnostic assertions, and trace references (From/Goto/DataStore). Returns JSON conforming to the ModelFactBundle schema with source metadata and per-fact location (Simulink block path). Requires Simulink license; Stateflow license optional for state detail.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the Simulink .slx model file to analyze.

outputFormat.description: Output format. Use 'model_fact_bundle' (default) for structured JSON.
